routes.name: Tourist Visa (on arrival)
routes.summary: Tourist visa is granted on arrival with no pre-approval. You need a return ticket, a prepaid booking at a registered facility, and enough funds, or an approved sponsorship. Submit the free Traveller Declaration within 96 hours before you arrive.

other: Passport with machine-readable zone, valid at least 1 month.
Confirmed return ticket, prepaid confirmed booking at a registered facility, and enough funds, or an approved sponsorship.
Must meet entry rules of the next destination.
Yellow fever certificate if arriving from or through a risk country (children under 1 exempt).
Entry is not granted on Israeli passports.
Each traveler, including kids, files their own declaration. Entry is decided by the officer at the border.

steps: Submit the free Traveller Declaration on the IMUGA portal up to 96 hours before arrival.
Show the declaration, ticket, booking and funds at immigration on arrival.
routes.processing: Tourist visa extensions are processed within about 48 hours through IMUGA (Immigration news, April 2026). Length of the free stay was not stated on the pages read.

routes.name: Business Visa
routes.summary: Multiple-entry visa for approved business purposes. You need an invitation from a locally registered business. Apply through the Ministry of Economic Development and Trade business portal before you arrive. Stay up to 90 days in total per 12 months.

other: Invited by a locally registered business or organization under the Business Visa Regulation.
Passport valid at least 6 months.
Photo taken within the last 3 months.
Must not be barred from entry under the Immigration Act.

steps: Download the eVisa from the portal.

routes.name: Meeting Visa
routes.summary: 14-day on-arrival visa for attending a meeting, conference or convention in the Maldives. Cannot be extended or switched to a Business Visa while in the country.

other: Main purpose is a meeting, conference or convention held in the Maldives (registered business, government, or approved by the relevant authority).
Return ticket, prepaid hotel booking and proof of funds.
Traveller Declaration on IMUGA within 96 hours before the flight.
Passport with machine-readable zone, valid at least 1 month.

routes.name: Work Visa (e-Visa)
routes.summary: Work visa for expats, applied for by the employer through the Xpat Online System. Employee arrives on an Entry Pass (Work Permit), then the employer gets the e-Visa within 15 days. Visa validity matches the work permit.

other: Work permit comes from the Ministry of Homeland Security and Technology.
Passport sticker visas stopped being valid after 23 November 2025. Only the e-Visa counts.
Renewed work visas are issued for 1 year max.

stay.note: Valid as long as the work permit. Renewals up to 1 year.

steps: Work Permit, then Visa tab, then Apply for Visa, New Request.
Upload photo and passport biodata page.

routes.name: Marriage Visa
routes.summary: Resident visa for the foreign spouse of a Maldivian citizen. First visa is 1 year, then renewals of up to 5 years. Your spouse needs a Sponsorship Declaration approved before you travel.

other: Legally married to a Maldivian citizen.
Medical report and health insurance for first-time applicants.
Already in the country on another visa? You can change category after the marriage is registered.

stay.note: Renewals up to 5 years. Apply within 2 months before expiry.

steps: Maldivian spouse files a Sponsorship Declaration on IMUGA.
Apply on IMUGA: Visa, Resident Visa, Marriage Visa.
Upload documents, submit, then download the eVisa.
documents: Latest arrival stamp or visa page
Medical report and health insurance (first time)

routes.name: Dependent Visa
routes.summary: For spouses, children under 18 and parents of someone on a professional category Work Visa. Fee is MVR 750. First entry needs an approved Sponsorship Declaration at least 7 working days before arrival.

other: Sponsor holds a professional category Work Visa.
Proof of relationship in English, medical report and expat health insurance.

routes.name: Sponsorship Declaration
routes.summary: Needed before someone enters on a sponsor's invitation, for visiting, dependent or marriage visas. Sponsor is a Maldivian or a professional category work visa holder. Usually processed in 5 working days. Sponsored person must enter within 30 days of approval.

other: Sponsor is a Maldivian citizen or holds a valid professional category Work Visa.
Sponsored person must be outside the Maldives when applying.

routes.name: Corporate Resident Visa
routes.summary: Resident visa for foreign investors. Qualify by investing USD 1,000,000 in the last three financial years, holding a USD 250,000 fixed deposit in a Maldives bank for five years, or investing USD 250,000 in a government-approved project. Apply on the ONEGov Portal.

investment.note: Lowest tier. Other tier is USD 1,000,000 invested in the last three financial years.

other: USD 250,000 fixed deposit in a licensed Maldives bank for 5 years also qualifies.

routes.name: Resident Visa (other categories)
routes.summary: Resident visas also go to people who stay eligible after a marriage to a Maldivian ends where they have a Maldivian child, and to those whose Maldivian spouse has died. Check Immigration for the details.

other: Details were not listed on the page. Check with Maldives Immigration.
